pairs.difference: A: the parasol's white frill is covered in small, crisp eyelet cut-outs, and the canopy has a lacquered sheen with a bright highlight streak along the ribs. B: the fan's paper folds are flat and matte, and the wooden sticks are simple smooth slats with no grain.
pairs.fix: Draw the frill as a smooth white ruffled band with no tiny cut-out holes, and make the canopy soft matte fabric with only a faint sheen.

pairs.difference: B: the leather straps have dashed stitch lines along both edges and rows of punched holes, the wood shows streaky grain on every plank, the gold buckles and corner caps are crisp, and the stone floor is speckled. A: the suitcase surface is a smooth orange shell with a few broad scuffs, and the stickers are clean flat shapes.
pairs.fix: Draw the straps as plain smooth leather bands with no stitch lines or holes, keep the wood grain faint, and draw the corners as a few broad smooth metal caps.

pairs.difference: A: the wooden frame has busy, contrasty grain streaks, the teddy's fur is a soft painterly smear, and the glowing bulbs and target have hot highlights with a hazy, noisy finish. B: the envelope paper is smooth and matte, and the postcard print is clean.
pairs.fix: Draw the wooden frame as smooth, softly shaded wood with only faint fine grain, and give the teddy a soft, even plush surface.

pairs.difference: B: the sneaker uppers carry a dense grid of tiny mesh dots, the laces have small rubber beads, and many glossy plastic parts sit next to each other with noisy shading. A: the hatbox is a smooth matte cylinder with a broad soft lid edge and a simple twisted rope.
pairs.fix: Draw the sneaker uppers as smooth, softly shaded fabric with no tiny mesh holes, and draw the laces as plain smooth cords.

pairs.difference: A: the piano's mahogany has big, decorative swirly grain under a mirror-lacquer finish, and the floorboards show mirror reflections and streaky grain; the whole card looks equally varnished. B: the guitar is a clean glossy red body, with matte white pickguard parts and simple frets.
pairs.fix: Draw the piano wood with a satin finish and only faint, fine grain, and make the floor a soft matte wood with no mirror reflections.

pairs.difference: A: the porcelain stand has bright white highlights everywhere, the tablecloth has fine crinkle texture, and the cake sponge layers show grainy pores. B: the fountain stone is a smooth matte sandstone with broad carved lobes, and the water is a clean translucent cyan.
pairs.fix: Make the cake stand softer, with one or two small highlights, and draw the tablecloth as smooth fabric with a few broad folds.

pairs.difference: B: the vending machine glass is covered in tiny condensation droplets, and the cans and bottles have small printed details behind a hazy glass. A: the teacup is uniformly glossy blue porcelain with clean gold rims and a broad reflection.
pairs.fix: Draw the vending machine glass as a clean, clear pane with no droplets, and show the drinks as simple smooth shapes.

pairs.difference: A: the gold watch case, chain and crown are mirror-shiny, with crisp knurling on the crown and many hard highlights on every chain link. B: the ring box is a soft matte velvet-red shell with a smooth beige cushion, and only the coin is shiny.
pairs.fix: Draw the gold as a softer satin finish with one broad highlight per part, draw the crown as a smooth knob without fine ridges, and make the chain a few simple smooth links.

pairs.difference: A: the top hat is a smooth dark felt with a soft sheen and a satin ribbon. B: the mortarboard is a smooth matte navy board with a simple cord. Both have a simplified finish that fits the real cards.

A: the fan paper has fine fold creases and slightly matte paper, with smooth yellow sticks. B: the scarf is soft matte cloth with broad folds and a smooth glossy badge. Neither shows a clear surface tell.

A: the rocking chair's wood has painterly streak grain and soft smeared edges, and the floorboards have big decorative grain lines. B: the ink bottle is clean translucent green glass with crisp highlights, the feather is matte, and the table grain is quiet.
pairs.fix: Draw the chair as smooth, softly shaded wood with only faint fine grain and clean edges, and make the floor quiet matte boards.

pairs.difference: A: the road asphalt is filled with fine speckle noise, and the bus has many small parts: wipers, mirror, seats and a ladder rail, all with crisp highlights. B: the neon ice cream is a smooth glowing tube with a simple waffle cross-hatch.
pairs.fix: Draw the road as a smooth, evenly shaded grey surface with no speckles, and simplify the bus into broad smooth panels.

pattern: The lessons show generated cards adding fine, crisp surface detail that real cards leave out. Stitch dashes and punched holes on leather, tiny mesh dots, knurling, droplets, speckled asphalt or stone, and busy, decorative wood grain all give a card away. So do mirror-gloss metal or lacquer on every part. Real cards keep surfaces smooth and slightly soft, reduce hardware to a few broad parts, and mix matte bodies with one or two glossy accents.
